title: AI coding agents ace isolated tests but complete fewer than one in ten tasks in a simulated workplace
summary: A new real-world test puts AI coding agents in a simulated developer job with colleagues, project boards, and incomplete handoffs, where they have to keep developing software on their own and reliably close open tickets in a messy daily workflow. Even Opus 5.5 and Astra fall far short, solving fewer than one in ten tasks completely. The models finish clear, standalone assignments quickly, but they lose track as autonomous developers. title: Perplexity's new Monitor API turns web search from a one-off query into a nonstop watchdog
summary: Perplexity is launching a Monitor API that searches the web on a schedule and alerts agents via webhook only when relevant changes occur. Its own decision model filters out unimportant results. For Perplexity, the API is part of a broader strategy to stand out from an increasingly interchangeable chatbot business through developer tools. summary: The Lean and Mathlib community has officially confirmed Levent Alpöge's proof of the Riemann hypothesis as correct. The solution arrived years earlier than expected: Terence Tao had predicted it wouldn't happen until around 2050 and didn't expect AI to solve it alone.
